race.comment: BEST TERMS (2) is the one to beat, boasting six placings from eight starts and a solid good-track record. His Ballarat heavy ground run was lacklustre after leading and racing keenly, but his earlier Horsham third keeps him competitive and this looks very winnable. CONJURER (3) has a more established maiden record, having been checked at Hamilton, but his St Arnaud third suggests potential here. With two placings from four attempts at this trip he should take holding out. A RUS IN GRINZING (11) recorded a strong last-start effort, finishing just a nose behind in a Class 1 at Gundagai despite racing wide, and dropping back to a maiden gives her strong winning claims. UNDER CONTROL (10) returns from a five-week break after a wide trip at Echuca; her previous Ballarat run was subpar, but she has enough pieces of form to be in the mix. FLYING RICHES (7) next best.
